mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its 12-month average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 4.7% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.7% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average during high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate production and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines below 12-month moving average and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals accelerating inflation that prompts delayed monetary easing, increasing real interest rates and depressing equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above its 4-quarter moving average indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 3-month moving average during declining retail sales (RSAFS < 350000 million dollars) signals broad consumer demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines below 3-month moving average and RSAFS is below 350000 million dollars, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
